init.title: Options
init.description: What would you like to change?

pin.title: Door opener PIN
pin.description: Optional PIN that lock.unlock has to pass as code before the door opens (4 to 8 digits). Leave empty for no PIN: then every unlock call opens the door, including voice assistants, dashboards and automations. Current setting: {state}.

auto_unlock.title: Schedule for "Next ring opens"
auto_unlock.description: Optional schedule helper. While it is on, Home Assistant opens the door on every ring that arrives by push. Switching "Next ring opens" off pauses the current period. Leave empty for no schedule.

push_missing.title: Ring push messages for {name} are not arriving
push_missing.description:
Home Assistant learned about the last rings of **{name}** only from the Ring integration's regular activity check, not from its instant push messages. Ring Intercom Plus still detects them, about a minute later.

To get instant rings back, reload or reconfigure the official Ring integration (Settings → Devices & services → Ring). This message disappears with the next ring that arrives by push.

next_ring_opens.name: Next ring opens for a time window
next_ring_opens.description: Switches "Next ring opens" on for the given time. The next ring that arrives by push within this time opens the door, then the switch turns off. 1 minute uses the intercom's own 60 s mode.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: 1 minute to 8 hours. Default: the time window set on the device.
